title: Builder 001 — Small Social Systems
thesis: The social graph is already full. Build the missing ritual.
position: Small social systems give existing groups lightweight structure—roles, shared state, time, handoffs, consent, and memory—without turning the group into an audience.
relationship_to_tag: TAG is one wedge: a social relay. Builder 001 may begin with TAG or choose an adjacent small-social-system white space.

edge_signals.name: Apple iMessage apps
edge_signals.signal: Games, media, and collaboration can live inside a conversation.

edge_signals.name: Discord Activities
edge_signals.signal: A channel or DM can become a shared multiplayer web application.

edge_signals.name: Telegram Mini Apps
edge_signals.signal: A web application can inherit chat context for cooperative and multiplayer use.

edge_signals.name: Spotify Messages and Jam
edge_signals.signal: A message can hand off into a synchronized shared music queue.

edge_signals.name: Locket
edge_signals.signal: A bounded close-friend circle can create ambient presence and private recaps.

edge_signals.name: Partiful
edge_signals.signal: An invitation can become a temporary social object with coordination, conversation, and shared memory.

inference: Existing platforms prove individual surfaces. The underbuilt layer is a portable, group-owned ritual that can move across chat, web, place, media, and memory without rebuilding a social graph.

white_spaces.title: Protocols, not destinations
white_spaces.test: Can the group explain and restart the rules without the builder?

white_spaces.title: One live thing everyone can feel
white_spaces.test: Does unfinished shared state pull someone back?

white_spaces.title: Alive together, tolerant of absence
white_spaces.test: Can a round survive a two-hour gap?

white_spaces.title: The recap is the reward
white_spaces.test: Does the group reshare what it made?

white_spaces.title: Identity as a temporary job
white_spaces.test: Do quieter people gain a clean entrance?

white_spaces.title: One link across incompatible chats
white_spaces.test: Does it work before account creation?

white_spaces.title: Consent is a feature surface
white_spaces.test: Can someone leave without social punishment?

white_spaces.title: Let geography write the prompt
white_spaces.test: Could this round happen only here?

white_spaces.title: Release a behavior like an edition
white_spaces.test: Is the pack recognizable as an author's voice?

white_spaces.title: Producer, not synthetic friend
white_spaces.test: Is the group—not the model—the main character?

builder_role.mission: Choose one underbuilt social behavior and make it playable with one real group.
builder_role.terms: AI credits are bounded operating support, not cash compensation. Cash costs, paid services, employment, contractor arrangements, ownership, and revenue share require a separate written agreement before work begins.

boundaries: no growth loop that punishes opting out
